title: First variation tested with vertical fields along the Lipschitz graph
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set, W ⊆ U open, R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), κ ∈ ℝ and H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x. Assume R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} with tsupport X ⊆ W, and that x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, where p_x is the orthogonal projection onto T_xM := approxTangentPlane n M x. Let ξ ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with B_r(ξ) ⊆ W (closed ball), T an n-dimensional subspace, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 and ιv ∈ T for all v, w, P : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝⁿ continuous linear with P(ιv) = v and P(ι'w) = 0 for all v, w, and f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ |v − w| and |f(v)| ≤ r/4 for all v, w. Assume (height) |(x − ξ) − p_T(x − ξ)| ≤ r/4 for every x ∈ spt μ ∩ B_r(ξ), and (tangent identification) for μ-a.e. x ∈ B_r(ξ) and every v ∈ ℝⁿ with x = ξ + ιv + ι'f(v): f is differentiable at v and T_xM = LinearMap.range(ι + ι'∘Df(v)) = {ιw + ι'Df(v)w : w ∈ ℝⁿ}. Put Φ(v) := ξ + ιv + ι'f(v), F := Φ(ℝⁿ), D := B̆ⁿ_{r/2}(0) (open ball of ℝⁿ), fʲ := EuclideanSpace.proj j ∘ f, ∂_ig(v) := Dg(v)e_i (Dg = fderiv ℝ g, e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1), tilt_T(x) := Σ_i|p_xe_i − p_Te_i|². Then: (i) for every j ∈ Fin k: ∫_{Φ(D)} ‖Dfʲ(P(x − ξ))‖² dμ ≤ 2∫_{B_r(ξ)} tilt_T dμ (lower integrals of ENNReal.ofReal); (ii) for every j ∈ Fin k, every C¹ function ζ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ D, and every G ∈ ℝ with ‖Dζ(v)‖ ≤ G for all v: ofReal|∫_{Φ(D)} Σ_{i=1}^{n} ∂_ifʲ(P(x − ξ))∂_iζ(P(x − ξ)) dμ| ≤ ofReal(G)·(∫_{B_r(ξ)} tilt_T dμ + μ(B_r(ξ) ∖ F) + ofReal(κr/2)·μ(B_r(ξ))), where the left integral is a Bochner integral and the integral of tilt_T is the lower integral of ENNReal.ofReal(tilt_T).
